clarity_findings.claim: The stability-tooltip screenshot caption is written as two sentences, violating style rule 8's "At most one caption sentence."
clarity_findings.problem: Line 22 of priv/help/en/systems/stability.md: `{shot:stability-tooltip#buildings,population|1. From buildings. 2. Lost to population.}`. The caption has two periods closing two independent clauses ("1. From buildings." and "2. Lost to population."), which is two sentences, not one. Rule 8 (§3.4) is explicit: "At most one caption sentence." Sibling leaf/guide pages in this same guide map fold multiple marks into a single sentence instead: population.md's two-mark shot caption reads as one sentence ("The growth word and the bar filling toward the next whole point, negative here because population is above housing."), and workforce.md's single-mark captions are each one sentence. stability.md is the only page in the set that uses a numbered, multi-sentence caption style.
clarity_findings.fix: Collapse the caption into one sentence covering both marks, e.g. "Stability from buildings, and stability lost to population." or "Buildings add stability, population subtracts from it." — matching the one-sentence, comma/and-joined pattern used by population.md's two-mark caption.
